title: Carrier helper phase is spread over armed AtomicBool, view Option, relay.closing_at Option and wait_for_browser bool
trigger: Open, lockdown, load, close and hangup each flip a different one of these
effect: None today; the phase (locking down, loading, running, closing, gone) is implied by which flags are set, and handlers re-derive it with `loading` and `closing_at` checks
fix: One `enum Phase { LockingDown, Loading, Closing{at,wait_for_browser}, Gone }` owned by the loop; the flag the web view callbacks read becomes a copy of it.

title: Relay document lifecycle kept as bridge_seen, receiving, started, load_finished and in_flight, reset by hand in load_started
trigger: Page loads, reloads in scope, says hello, takes onmessage, posts
effect: None today; `next` and `failure` re-derive the stage from four fields and a new field must be added to `load_started`'s reset list
fix: `enum Document { Loading, Loaded, BridgeUp, Listening, Started }` replaced whole in load_started; in_flight lives with Listening.

title: A late Ack from the pre-reload document terminates the carrier
trigger: A delivery is in flight, the relay page reloads inside the scope; the old document's Ack IPC message arrives after LoadStarted had already moved the delivery back to pending
effect: heard() finds no matching in_flight and returns Err, so the carrier fails with Terminated and the proxy is dropped although nothing is wrong
fix: Tag acks with a document epoch (part of the Document enum) and ignore acks from an older epoch instead of failing.

title: Mini-app shell readiness is a shell_ready bool plus a queued Vec kept in step by hand, with a silent 256 cap
trigger: Quill sends commands before the shell page script posts shell_ready
effect: None today; commands beyond 256 before ready are dropped without a trace, and if the shell page ever reloaded, shell_ready stays true while window.__quillShell is gone so commands are dropped by the script guard
fix: `enum Shell { Booting(Vec<HostCommand>), Ready }` reset to Booting on any top-level shell navigation; capture_at joins as a variant of the same phase.

title: claim treats an unreadable or missing owner.json as no previous owner, so a different user inherits the old user's data
trigger: Sign in as user A, owner.json write fails (full disk, read-only) or the file is corrupt or deleted; A logs out without forget finishing or the folder predates owner.json; user B signs in on the same account-N slot
effect: previous is None, so claim returns false and nothing is forgotten: B sees A's agent grants, mini app trust, recent hashtags, widget storage and mini app web data
fix: Make the owner a typed `Owner::{Unknown, Known(user_id)}`; Unknown with leftover per-account files counts as someone else and forgets, and a failed owner write is reported instead of only logged.

title: Deferred web view delete outlives the account slot and can wipe the data of the next sign-in under the same key
trigger: Account-1 logs out while its mini app helper is open (delete waits on helper_gone); the user signs in again as account-1 and opens a mini app; the old helper then exits
effect: remove_dir_all(webview_dir) removes the new session's live web view folder and store-salt.key, so its mini app storage vanishes and the store id changes mid-session
fix: Key the deferred delete by an owner generation (the salt value read at forget time) and delete only if the folder still holds that salt.

title: MCP bridge link stage is an Option<Link> plus an AtomicBool alive plus a pending map kept in step by hand
trigger: Agent sends a request after Quill closed the socket
effect: forward() drops the link when alive is false and reopens; relay() flips alive and drains pending on its own thread
fix: One LinkState enum (Closed, Open{send,pending}, Dead) owned by the relay, with pending drained on the transition to Dead.

title: Request written to a link whose relay already drained pending is never answered
trigger: Quill closes the socket (access turned off) at the moment an agent sends tools/call: forward() saw alive=true, relay() then sets alive=false and drains pending, forward() inserts the id afterwards and the write to the dying socket still succeeds
effect: The agent's request hangs with no answer or error until the agent times out
fix: Insert into pending and check the Dead transition under one lock (pending: Mutex<Pending::{Open(map),Dead}>), and answer at once when Dead.

title: resources/subscribe is lost silently when the bridge reconnects
trigger: Agent subscribes to quill://unread; Quill restarts or Agent access is toggled off and on; the next forwarded call opens a new link
effect: The old server-side watcher stopped with its connection and nothing resubscribes, so the agent believes it is subscribed and never hears about new messages
fix: Keep the subscription as bridge state (subscribed: Set<Uri>) and replay it on open_link, or tell the agent with an error when the link it subscribed on died.

title: Subscription watcher stage is an AtomicU64 where 0 means none and a number is the current watcher token
trigger: resources/subscribe then unsubscribe then subscribe on one connection
effect: watching (0/token) plus StopOnDrop plus the watcher's own compare_exchange keep the stage; the token makes it safe today
fix: A small Subscription enum (None, Watching{token}) behind one type, so the 0 sentinel is not repeated at three call sites.

title: A write that already went out is reported to the agent as 'Agent access is off'
trigger: Agent calls send_message; the user turns Agent access off (or presses Revoke) while the tool runs; the tool finishes the send, then Reply::drop replaces its result with the ACCESS_OFF error
effect: The agent is told its action did not run though the message was sent, and may retry it after access is back on, sending twice
fix: Let a finished tool result win for write tools (send the result with a note that access went off) or make Reply carry whether the call had side effects.

title: Failed save of agent grants is only logged, the cache keeps the new value
trigger: User removes a chat grant (or turns All chats off) while agent_grants.json cannot be written (disk full, read-only); the Settings page shows it revoked
effect: Agents are refused this run; after restart the old grant is read back from disk and the revoked chat is readable again with no sign to the user
fix: Make change_all return Result and have the Settings page show the save error; keep the cache equal to what is on disk.

title: download_file copies a chat's file to the agent's path after access was revoked or turned off during the download
trigger: An agent calls download_file on a large file (waits up to 5 minutes). While it downloads the user turns Agent access off, revokes that chat's grant, or revokes the agent's connection. The download finishes.
effect: The file is copied to the agent's chosen folder although the user withdrew access. Only a lock is checked (locked_since_call_began); still_allowed (access generation, grants generation, revoked connection) is never called, unlike every write tool.
fix: Call still_allowed() after call_waiting returns and before copy_new, and treat download_file as a write-class call (or re-run require(Scope::Read) after the wait).

title: Chat class cache (OwnChannel/Bot/Saved) is process-wide, never invalidated and never pruned
trigger: An agent reads the user's channel (class OwnChannel, covered by the own-channels default). The user then transfers ownership or leaves it. The agent calls again.
effect: classify returns the cached OwnChannel, so the grant default keeps applying to a channel the user no longer owns until Quill restarts. The maps also keep an entry per (client, chat) for every closed client.
fix: Key the cache by the live Client and drop it with the client (or do not cache OwnChannel and re-read the supergroup status per call).

title: Agent requests of a closed client wait the full timeout instead of ending
trigger: An agent runs download_file or a slow read; meanwhile the user logs out or removes that account (client route closes).
effect: The waiter stays in PENDING with nothing to wake it: the agent thread blocks for 30 s (300 s for downloads) and then reports 'no answer from Telegram, check the connection' instead of 'signed out'.
fix: When a client's route closes, drain its PENDING entries (key them by client id) and answer TdError::Send.

title: copy_new leaves an empty or partial file at the destination when the copy fails
trigger: download_file with a 'to' folder; the cached source file was evicted or the disk fills after create_new succeeded.
effect: The create_new file stays behind (empty or cut short) and the next try writes 'name (2)'; the agent is told the copy failed but a broken file sits in the user's folder.
fix: Copy to a temp name in the destination folder and rename it into place, removing it on any error.

title: wait_for_message remembers a failed grant lookup as 'not granted' for the whole wait
trigger: wait_for_message with no chat; a first message from chat X arrives while getUser/getSupergroup times out, so granted() errs. More messages from X arrive in the next minutes.
effect: The error is cached as false in `checked` (and in `known` for the unread watcher), so every later message of X is dropped for the rest of the wait and the agent sees 'No new message'.
fix: Cache only Ok answers; on Err leave the chat unknown and ask again for the next message.

title: td_call asks the user to Allow a send that is then refused for a reason known beforehand
trigger: An agent td_calls a money-class send (sendMessage with paid content) into a bot the user never talked to, or with no chat_id.
effect: The user is shown a prompt and clicks Allow; only afterwards grants.writable() refuses (stranger bot / no chat_id), so the click had no effect.
fix: Run grants.writable(first_chat) before ask_user for methods in SENDS.

title: 'Inside a call' is an Option in a thread-local that CallScope::drop resets to None
trigger: A tool run that calls call_on/CallScope::begin again on the same thread (nested), or code spawning work on another thread.
effect: No bug today (one caller, server.rs). A nested scope would clear the outer call's CallStart on drop, so still_allowed would answer 'locked' for the outer write; on another thread CALL is None and every write refuses.
fix: Make the scope restore the previous value (or carry CallStart in Ctx) instead of a thread-local Option.

title: AGENT thread-local keeps the last agent's name after the call ends
trigger: Agent A's call finishes on a pooled thread; code that runs later on that thread outside a call (a prompt, an activity row) calls current_agent().
effect: It names agent A instead of 'An agent'. Today every caller is inside a call, so only a future caller is hit.
fix: Clear AGENT in CallScope::drop, or pass the agent name in Ctx.

title: request_access keeps `ask`, `what` and `granted_chat` in step by hand per branch
trigger: Any edit to one of the three branches (contacts, all chats, one chat).
effect: No bug today. `granted_chat.is_some()` is the stage 'asking for a chat' and must match the Ask variant; a branch that sets one without the other gives a wrong 'allowed' message.
fix: One enum Request {Contacts, AllChats, Chat{id,title}} that yields both the Ask and the answer text.

title: Offset tokens are global: not bound to the account, agent or method that got them
trigger: Agent A gets next_offset token 5 from searchMessages on account X. Agent B (or a td_call on account Y) passes quill-offset:5 as offset.
effect: The real offset (date,chat_id,message_id) of A's answer is substituted into B's request. Answers still pass the grant redaction, so only odd paging results, not a leak.
fix: Store (account, method, offset) with the token and refuse it for another account or method.

title: testmode adds the account first and marks it test second; a failed marker write leaves a production account named 'Test environment'
trigger: On the sign-in screen of the only account type testmode; the account store is added (add_account saves the registry), then the marker write fails (disk full, read-only folder, antivirus lock). The user gets the 'could not switch the environment' note.
effect: The registry keeps a second, signed-out account called 'Test environment' that connects to production (no marker). The account count is now 2, so plan_test_mode returns None and the testmode code never works again until the user removes that account by hand; signing in there puts a production login under a test name.
fix: Write the marker before the account is registered (or roll back with remove_account on error), so 'registered' and 'environment known' are one step; better, store the environment in the AccountRecord as an enum Environment{Production,Test}.

title: Revoke refuses an agent by its self-declared client name, so it is both evadable and too broad
trigger: Settings > Agent access: Disconnect an agent connected as 'Claude Code' (or one that sent no client name, shown 'An agent'). server.rs authenticate() takes the name from the unauthenticated-by-identity 'client' param; revoke() pushes that name into REFUSED and serve() checks activity::refused(&agent).
effect: The revoked process still holds the valid token and reconnects under any other --client name and is accepted; meanwhile every other agent that reports the same name (a second Claude Code session, or every nameless agent as 'An agent') is refused until the user clicks Allow again or restarts.
fix: Make the connection identity an id minted by Quill (and a token per client, or revoke = reset token); refuse by that identity, and show name only as a label.

title: Debug mode switch keeps three copies (in-memory flag, withdebug file, TDLib native stream) in step by hand and ignores failures
trigger: Type 'debugmode' and confirm. Turning on: debug_mode::set_enabled(true) runs before start_tdlib_log; if TDLib rejects the stream the error note shows but the flag stays on and the file is persisted '1'. Turning off: stop_tdlib_log result is discarded (let _), so if secure_native_logging fails TDLib keeps writing debug-level tdlib.log.
effect: UI says debug logs are off (or on) while TDLib still writes (or does not write) its debug log, which the confirm text says can hold account data; next launch repeats the mismatch because hub.rs also drops the start error.
fix: One DebugLog enum {Off, On, OnButTdlibClosed(error)} owned by the app, set only after the TDLib call answered, with the failure shown and the persisted flag following the enum.

title: Secret codes are fed from every keystroke on the sign-in screen, including the phone, login-code and 2FA password fields
trigger: Sign in with a cloud password that contains 'testmode', 'viewlogs', 'debugmode' or 'numberbuttons' (or paste such text); AdvancedUi observes all keystrokes of the main window and code_screen() is SignIn whenever the account is not Ready.
effect: Mid-password, testmode adds a new test account and switches away (the typed text is lost), debugmode opens the confirm box. The buffer also holds the tail of typed secrets that is a code prefix.
fix: Feed only when no text input has focus (a CodeSource enum on the screen), and clear the buffer when the screen or focus changes.

title: An agent connection's stage lives in three parallel statics (CONNECTED, REVOKED, REFUSED) kept in step by hand
trigger: revoke() pushes the id into REVOKED and the name into REFUSED after reading CONNECTED separately; Presence::drop removes from two of the three; allow_all_again clears only REFUSED.
effect: No bug today beyond TMP-002 (a connection that drops between the find and the push leaves a dead id in REVOKED), but the stages Live/Revoked/Closed/Refused are not one value.
fix: One Vec<Connection{id, agent, tools, stage: Live|Revoked}> under one mutex plus a refused set keyed by the Quill-made identity.

title: Lock pause is an AtomicBool plus a lock counter plus a generation, ordered by comment
trigger: set_paused_by_lock stores the flag then bumps LOCKS; set_enabled(false)/reset_token bump GENERATION; calls compare flag and counters at start and end.
effect: Correct today thanks to the documented store order; a new writer that bumps one without the other would silently let a locked call return its result.
fix: One AgentGate state value (epoch: u64, locked: bool) in a single atomic/mutex so 'locked since' is one comparison.

title: debug_confirm Option<bool> mirrors an open DebugModeConfirm box
trigger: run_secret_code sets debug_confirm = Some(enabled()) then open_box(DebugModeConfirm); only the box's on_close clears it.
effect: If the box is closed by a path other than its on_close (account switch, close-all), the Some stays until the next code; harmless today because the next open overwrites it.
fix: Carry the 'currently on' snapshot in the dialog kind (DialogKind::DebugModeConfirm{on}) so the box and its payload are one value.

title: A send that Telegram has not delivered in 30 s is reported and logged as sent with its temporary message id
trigger: Agent sends a message while the network is slow (no updateMessageSendSucceeded within DELIVERY_WAIT), then the user opens the activity log and clicks undo or the agent edits/deletes by the returned id
effect: The tool answers ok with a local temporary id; the activity row stores that id in message_ids, so undo/open acts on a stale id (nothing, or an error) after the message gets its final id, and a later failure of the send is never reported
fix: Make the send result an enum Delivered(final) / Failed / StillSending(temp id) and log StillSending as such, resolving the id when the update arrives instead of storing the temp id.

title: One failed message in an album or forward fails the whole call although the others were delivered
trigger: Agent calls send_file with 3 to 10 files or forward_messages with many ids and one slot ends Sent::Failed while others succeed
effect: The call returns an error, the log records ok=false with no message_ids (so nothing can be undone), and the agent retries, sending duplicates
fix: Return a per-message outcome list (Delivered/Failed) and log the delivered ids; error only when none was delivered.

title: The composer-clear command after an agent UI send is fire and forget
trigger: Two agents keep the bridge queue full (8 waiting) while one send finishes; bridge::post returns Busy and the result is discarded with let _
effect: The message was sent but the composer still holds the text, so the user's next Enter sends it again
fix: Hand the send and its clear over as one UiSend stage (Sent) that the UI acknowledges, or retry the post and report failure in the tool answer.

title: UiSend names the chat by a bare id, not the account's chat
trigger: The user switches account in the window between the UI answering the click on Send and the tool thread running finish_ui_send (Ctx::active is read afterwards)
effect: granted() runs against the new account with the old account's chat id; if that id exists there (same user id for a private chat) the text goes to that chat from the wrong account
fix: Put an AccountChat owner key in UiSend and refuse in finish_ui_send when Ctx::active is another account.

title: A screenshot is reserved against the rate limits before the command runs and not given back when the command fails
trigger: Agent calls click_element with screenshot true while the driver is Busy, times out, or the UI refuses (hidden window, blocked surface)
effect: The reservation is spent, so the retry or the next take_screenshot is refused as rate limited for a second, and 20 failed tries lock screenshots for a minute
fix: Reserve only when the UI reports it will take the picture, or release the reservation on Err/Refused.

title: Adding a chat to a folder rewrites the whole folder from a read taken before the queue turn
trigger: User edits the folder (renames it, adds chats) in Quill or another device while the agent runs set_chat_folder (getChatFolder happens before take_write_turn, which can wait on the paced queue)
effect: editChatFolder sends the stale folder back and silently undoes the user's folder change
fix: Do the read inside the same queue turn as the write, or send only a delta; re-read right before editChatFolder.

title: mute_chat writes back the full notification settings read earlier
trigger: User changes the chat's sound or preview settings between the agent's getChat and setChatNotificationSettings
effect: The user's change is overwritten with the old values
fix: Read and write in one turn; only change mute_for.

title: Folder add/remove edits the lists without checking pinned and excluded rules
trigger: remove: true on a chat that is only in included_chat_ids adds it to excluded_chat_ids (burning the folder's limit); add on a chat that is in pinned_chat_ids pushes it into included_chat_ids too
effect: TDLib refuses with CHATLIST_INCLUDE_INVALID, which the tool reports as 'Folder is full'
fix: Model membership as an enum (Pinned/Included/Excluded/None) and compute the lists from it; map the error truthfully.

title: Every error from getMessage is reported as 'There is no message'; and a failed re-read after a successful edit reports the edit as failed
trigger: Network or TDLib error on getMessage (flood, timeout) during react/pin/delete, or the re-read at the end of edit_message fails after editMessageText succeeded
effect: The agent is told the message does not exist (or the edit failed) and may retry or give up wrongly
fix: Separate NotFound from other TdError; after a successful edit fall back to the request data.

title: A write waits up to two minutes for a click after the agent has gone away
trigger: Agent calls send_message with Confirm each send on, then cancels the request or disconnects (not revoked); the user later clicks Allow within 120 s
effect: The message is sent for a call nobody waits on; the agent never sees the result and may send it again
fix: Tie the prompt to the call: withdraw it when the connection closes or the request is cancelled and check that in still_allowed.

title: A command the UI already ran is reported as a timeout and the agent retries it
trigger: UI thread injects a click or keys, then takes more than 15 s to settle or answer; Ticket::wait sets cancelled after the injection and returns Timeout
effect: Tool says the window did not answer; the agent retries, so a toggle or a send click runs twice
fix: Make the stage one enum (Queued, Running, Answered, Abandoned) and report 'ran, answer lost' when Running at timeout.

title: A queued UI command's lifecycle is queue membership plus a cancelled atomic plus a one-shot channel
trigger: Any driver command
effect: Stage (queued, taken by UI, answered, abandoned) is implied by where the Pending sits and a flag; withdraw, take and cancel must be kept in step by hand
fix: enum CommandStage {Queued, Running, Answered, Abandoned} behind one handle.

title: Drive and real-input clocks use 0 as a 'never' sentinel in process-wide atomics
trigger: Agent drives, user types, takeover pause
effect: Option<Instant> kept as u64 with 0 meaning none; shared across accounts and windows
fix: Option<Instant> in one DriverClock owned by the takeover record.

title: Screenshots travel to the MCP answer through a thread-local side channel
trigger: Any tool call with a screenshot
effect: The answer's images exist only if the same thread drains ATTACHED in tools::call_on; a tool path that attaches and then errors, or runs on another thread, leaks or loses the picture (call_on currently clears it before and after)
fix: Return images in ToolOutput instead of a thread-local.

title: read_zip accumulates one inflated copy per central-directory entry; a crafted theme zip exhausts memory
trigger: Import (or open) a .tdesktop-theme under 5 MB whose central directory lists ~65535 entries that all point at one local header holding a 4 MB deflate stream (about 4 KB compressed, size field 4 MB). Each entry passes the per-entry size check and is inflated and pushed into `out`.
effect: Memory grows by about 4 MB per entry (hundreds of GB total) until the allocator aborts: the whole app crashes (import runs on a background thread, but an OOM abort kills the process; store::load on the UI thread freezes it first).
fix: Keep a running total of inflated bytes (cap it near BACKGROUND_LIMIT + SCHEME_LIMIT), reject duplicate local-header offsets, and only inflate the entries ThemeFile::parse asks for by name.

title: ArchiveMute::reload_pending is cleared only by a successful settings answer; the error arm leaves it set
trigger: Server sends suggestedActionEnableArchiveAndMuteNewChats while the network is flaky (or send_json fails in reload_archive_chat_list_settings), so getArchiveChatListSettings fails. chat_list/error.rs resets archive_settings_loading but not archive_mute.reload_pending. Cached settings exist, so nothing reloads again.
effect: suggestion_due stays false for the rest of the session: the 'Hide new chats?' box never appears and the reload is never retried.
fix: Make the reload a stage enum (Idle, Reloading, Failed) owned by ArchiveMute and leave Reloading in the error arm and the send-failure arm of reload_archive_chat_list_settings.

title: load_ai_style_example returns after start_next with no driver, leaving the example loading forever
trigger: Open the style preview (addstyle link) and press 'Another example' while self.live is None (account closing, client gone, demo session). start_next() has set loading and example_asked_at, then `let Some(live) = self.live.as_mut() else { return; }` exits without failed().
effect: The refresh icon spins forever, 'Another example' stays disabled, and ai_style_preview_upkeep requests an animation tick every 60 ms (redraw loop) until the box is closed.
fix: Make the example an enum (Idle, Asked{token, at}, Failed) so every early return goes through one place that leaves Asked, or call failed() on the live-None path.

title: Style example request stage is split over StyleExamples.loading, AiStylePreview.example_token and example_asked_at
trigger: Each starter (load_ai_style_example) and each exit (loaded, failed, send error) must set or clear three fields together by hand.
effect: No bug today beyond TMP-003, but a new exit path that misses one field sticks the spinner.
fix: enum ExampleFetch { Idle, Asked { token, at }, } inside StyleExamples (shown count beside it), with loaded(token) matching the token.

title: Archive-and-mute setting stage is reload_pending + ChatListState::archive_settings_loading + archive_chat_list_settings Option
trigger: The suggestion arrival sets reload_pending, the request sets archive_settings_loading, the answer sets the Option and clears both by hand in different files.
effect: Two bools kept in step across files; TMP-002 is the resulting stick.
fix: Fetch<ArchiveChatListSettings> plus a single 'stale since suggestion' marker inside the Fetch's Reloading variant.

title: EmojiPlays keeps played, generations and replays as three sets/maps changed together by key
trigger: started, replay, leave_chat and clear each edit the three collections by hand; the key is a bare (chat id, message id) pair with no account in it, relying on stop_sticker_playback at an account switch.
effect: No bug found: all three are cleared together today, and the switch calls clear. A new writer missing one collection would replay or rest wrongly.
fix: One HashMap<MessageKey, Play> with Play { generation, state: Played|Replaying }, keyed by ChatMessage inside the per-account OnScreen players.

title: BoostBoxState keeps phase, note and reassigning in step by hand
trigger: Click Reassign: boost_flow sets phase=Working, note=None and reassigning=Some together; apply.rs, error.rs and the send-failure arm each reset phase and reassigning separately.
effect: No bug today, but reassigning is only valid while phase is Working and a missed reset leaves a stale summary that turns the next boost's note into a wrong 'N boosts are reassigned' line.
fix: Make the Working variant carry the optional ReassignSummary (Working{reassign: Option<ReassignSummary>}) so leaving Working drops it.

title: open_boost_box replaces the box but leaves boost_intent and stashed slots of the old chat
trigger: In the boost box of channel A press Boost (getAvailableChatBoostSlots out, boost_intent=A), then open a t.me/B?boost link so open_boost_box(B) swaps the box before the slots answer arrives.
effect: The slots answer is stashed for A (intent still A) and maybe_continue_boost sends boostChat for A with a free slot while the user is looking at B's box: a boost is spent on a chat the screen no longer shows.
fix: Fold intent into the box state (BoostPhase::Working carries the chat and request id) or clear boost_intent and boost_slots_by_chat whenever boost_box is replaced, as close_boost_box does.

title: Optimistic pause/resume and remove of the business bot are not rolled back on error
trigger: In a private chat managed by a business bot press Stop (or Remove bot) while TDLib rejects the request (offline, flood, bot already removed).
effect: The bar shows 'bot paused' (or disappears) although the bot still runs; the error path only sets chats_state.chat_action_error, so the wrong bar stays until a later updateChatBusinessBotManageBar or reopening the app.
fix: Keep the bar as a Toggling{from,to} / Removing stage keyed by the request, and restore the previous bar in the ToggleBusinessBotPaused/RemoveBusinessBotFromChat error arms (src/state/domains/chats/error.rs:58).

title: premium_flooded is a sticky bool beside CardState and is never cleared
trigger: A free user opens the AI compose box and a request fails with AICOMPOSE_FLOOD_PREMIUM; they then buy Premium from the Increase Limit button (or switch to Fix/another tab and get a good result) without closing the box.
effect: footer() keeps returning IncreaseLimit for the life of the box, so a Ready result cannot be applied, and dialog.rs hides the loading spinner for later requests (loading && !premium_flooded).
fix: Make the flood a CardState::Failed(AiBoxError) variant (or derive it from the last card) so the next request or accepted result leaves it.

title: A failed Fix request has no retry: set_mode(same mode) returns None and the card stays Failed
trigger: Open the box, switch to the Fix tab, the request fails (network error, TooLong or an empty answer); click the Fix tab again.
effect: Card shows the original text with a disabled Apply and no spinner; the only way to ask again is to switch to another tab and back (or close and reopen).
fix: Give CardState::Failed a retry transition (re-clicking the active tab or a Retry action calls request() when the card is Failed).

title: refresh_styles drops a vanished translate_style but neither re-asks nor invalidates the card
trigger: On the Translate tab pick a custom style and get a result (or leave it loading); the server then removes that style (updateTextCompositionStyles from another device).
effect: translate_style becomes None so the title reads 'To <language>' while the shown/arriving result was made with the removed style, and Apply applies it.
fix: Route the Translate branch through request_in(Translate) like the Style branch so the stale card is replaced.

title: bound_style_name is app-wide but custom styles are per account
trigger: Account A binds its custom style 'pirate' to the apply-in-place shortcut; switch to account B (no such style) and press the shortcut in a chat.
effect: The request fails with a style-invalid error, apply_in_place.rs clears the binding for the whole app, so account A's binding is lost; with a same-named different style in B the wrong style rewrites the text.
fix: Key the binding by AccountKey (map AccountKey -> style name) or store it in the account's settings.

title: Facts keeps paused/paused_ms/stopped/session.ended_ms in step by hand
trigger: n/a (no bug found: phase() derives the display, forget_hold/observe clear pause and Stop at the switch).
effect: paused_ms is meaningful only while paused is Some; stopped (bool) and paused (Option) are two stages of one hold; Session.ended_ms is an Option used as an 'ended' flag beside the HOLD timeout.
fix: One enum Hold { None, Paused{reason,since_ms}, Stopped } in Facts, and Session { Running{..} | Ended{at_ms} }.

title: Screenshot rate-limit slot is spent before the screenshot is taken
trigger: An agent calls take_screenshot (or an input tool with screenshot:true) while the window is hidden, the surface is blocked, or the user is dragging; the command is refused.
effect: reserve() already counted it, so the agent's immediate retry gets 'try again in N s' and 20 refused attempts exhaust the minute budget with no screenshot taken.
fix: Reserve when the capture is about to run (or release the slot on refusal) instead of at the tool entry.

title: Injection state is INJECTING + OPEN counter + LAST_STEP + REFUSALS thread-locals kept in step by hand
trigger: n/a (with_injecting and OpenCommand::drop restore them on the normal paths).
effect: INJECTING is set/cleared by paired set_injecting calls (perform_step) with no guard object, so a panic or early return between them leaves every real write refused; LAST_STEP is never cleared and names a stale agent for later deferred refusals.
fix: One RAII Injection guard (stores previous state, restores on Drop) owning the agent/tool and refusal list.

title: Frames tracks the PipeWire stream stage as streamed + paused bools
trigger: Share a Wayland screen, then the compositor pauses the cast
effect: Pause is only reported after a first Streaming; the two bools are kept in step by hand in state_changed
fix: One enum StreamPhase { Connecting, Streaming, Paused } with transitions in state_changed.

title: Window pause state is a local paused bool in each capture's poll loop (X11 run, mac and Windows WindowMonitor)
trigger: Share a window, minimise it, restore it
effect: Paused/Resumed events are derived by comparing a local bool with the polled visibility; the consumer keeps its own ActiveScreen.paused copy
fix: A shared ShareVisibility enum { Visible, Hidden } with a transition fn returning the event to push.

title: WinCapture.closed bool sits beside Shared.stopped AtomicBool for one stop stage
trigger: stop() or the item Closed event
effect: Two separate flags (closed for stop idempotence, stopped for callbacks) must agree; end() and stop() set only one each
fix: One CaptureStage { Running, Stopped } on Shared, used by both stop() and end().

title: A lost output device silently ends system audio while the call still says it is sharing it
trigger: Share a screen with system audio on Windows, then unplug headphones or change the default output
effect: The error callback calls StreamErrors::check and discards the Fatal result; the stream goes dead, the mix queue drains, and CallScreen::sharing_audio() stays true with no event or toast
fix: Report a fatal stream error back to the opener (a channel or DeviceRun::Failed) so SharedAudio leaves its running stage and the UI shows audio off.

title: A start that times out leaves the SCStream possibly capturing with no owner
trigger: Start a screen share while macOS is slow to answer startCapture (over 5 s)
effect: recv_timeout fails and start returns Err, but stopCapture is never called and the stream is only dropped; if the handler fires late the system may keep the stream and the recording indicator on while Quill shows the share as failed
fix: On the timeout and error arms call stream.stopCaptureWithCompletionHandler(None) and mark StreamShared stopped before returning.

title: The window monitor reports Ended without marking the stream stopped, unlike Windows
trigger: Share a window on macOS, then close that window
effect: Monitor pushes Ended and exits but StreamShared.stopped stays false, so frames keep flowing until the consumer stops and the SCStream delegate may push a second Ended
fix: Have the monitor end through a shared end() that swaps stopped once, as screen_win does.

title: call_link_after_leave is never cleared on a failed leave, a cancel, a new call or an account switch
trigger: In a call, open a voice chat link, confirm 'End call and join'. discard_call/leave_group_call errors are discarded (`let _ =`) so the call stays up (network down). Keep using the app; later hang up the call normally.
effect: maybe_offer_pending_call_link runs from ingest once no call is on and silently offers/fetches the old link's call, opening a join screen the user abandoned long ago; nothing else ever clears the Option.
fix: Fold call_link/call_link_confirm/call_link_after_leave into one CallLinkStage enum (Idle, Asking(confirm), Leaving{chat,hash,since_call}, Offered(link)) whose Leaving arm exits on the leave error, on a different call starting, and in CallBoxes::farewell.

title: Link confirmed after leaving a call loses live_stream and the stream join intent
trigger: In a voice chat, open a channel live stream link (?livestream=), confirm 'Leave and join live stream'. call_link_after_leave stores only (chat_id, hash) and maybe_offer_pending_call_link calls offer_call_link(.., false).
effect: The UI path (ui/call_link_ui.rs offer_call_link) that calls note_stream_join_intent(StreamJoinIntent::Call) and shows 'Opening the live stream' is skipped, so the stream does not open in its window and no note shows; a repeated Busy would also word the question as a voice chat.
fix: Keep the whole CallLinkConfirm (or a LinkTarget{chat,hash,live_stream}) in the Leaving stage and report the resulting CallLinkStep back to the UI so it records the join intent.

title: Call link flow spread over three session Options
trigger: Open a call link while in a call.
effect: call_link (offered hash), call_link_confirm (question) and call_link_after_leave (queued offer) are stages of one flow kept in step by hand; only leave_group_call_local and cancel_call_link_leave clear parts, and call_link (hash) outlives a dismissed join screen.
fix: One enum CallLinkStage { Idle, Asking(CallLinkConfirm), Leaving(target), Offered(PendingCallLink) } owned by the call state, reset in one place.

title: CpalMic stage is stream Option plus a failure Mutex<Option<String>> plus a Failed event
trigger: Unplug the microphone during a call or level test.
effect: Running/stopped/failed are encoded by `stream: Option<Stream>` and `error` (get_or_insert keeps the first text, cleared only in start) and reported twice (error slot and CaptureEvent::Failed); LevelTap reads only the slot, the call path only the event, so the two can disagree.
fix: enum MicState { Stopped, Running(Stream), Failed(CaptureError) } shared through one slot that both readers use.

title: Feeder stage is stop + forwarding + sink.closed atomics
trigger: Pause/resume screen share, end the call.
effect: Running/paused/stopping live in three AtomicBools (stop, forwarding, closed) that Drop and set_forwarding keep in step by hand; the thread's exit has two different conditions (stop and closed).
fix: One AtomicU8-backed FeederMode { Forwarding, Paused, Stopped }.

title: Engine refusals of capture frames are counted but never shown
trigger: Join a call where the engine rejects external frames (qc_external_frame error, e.g. after the transport drops): every frame fails.
effect: FeederStats::failed/rejected/last_error are read nowhere outside tests (only stats().sent() is used), so the microphone or screen share looks live while nothing reaches the call; the failure is only an eprintln once a second. last_error is also never cleared after recovery.
fix: Have the driver poll the stats and turn a run of failures into CaptureEvent::Failed / an ActiveCapture error stage.

title: Portal fd is converted to a raw fd before pw_context_connect_fd can fail
trigger: Start a Wayland screen share where pw_context_connect_fd returns null.
effect: fd.into_raw_fd() hands ownership away before the call, so on failure the descriptor is neither closed by PipeWire nor by Rust and leaks for the process lifetime.
fix: Keep the OwnedFd until the call succeeds (pass as_raw_fd/dup, forget it only on success).

title: MicProcessor.denoised_last remembers the previous frame's mode
trigger: Toggle noise suppression or mute while a call is running.
effect: A bool tracks whether the last frame was denoised so the RNNoise state is rebuilt; mute path, off path and on path each set it by hand, and it is the only record of the mode.
fix: enum Denoise { Off, On(Box<DenoiseState>) } so switching on constructs a fresh state and off drops it.

title: CreateJoinAs answer is Option<Result<_,()>> in the session, consumed only by a waiting box
trigger: Start video chat in a group, then close the 'Start' box (or switch chat) before getUserAvailableParticipants answers; or the request is dropped without an answer/error
effect: The answer stays in calls.create_join_as until the next request overwrites it; if no answer or error ever arrives the box sits in CreateStep::Waiting with no way out except the user cancelling. In-flight, answered and failed are one Option<Result> plus a separate failed_creates side list
fix: Make the create flow one enum on the box (Asking(request) / Answered(list) / Failed) owned by GroupCallCreate via the Asker seam, so closing the box drops the request and an answer is matched to it; remove the session-level create_join_as.

title: Conference lifecycle is handle (null) + closed bool + two request queues kept in step by hand
trigger: Null handle means both 'not attached yet' and 'closed'; attach, close, deliver and set_owners each re-check closed under the media lock
effect: No bug today (locks are consistent), but a new path that forgets the closed check would keep or send answers for a destroyed instance
fix: One enum behind the media mutex: Unattached{unsent} / Attached{handle} / Closed, with pending requests inside the live variants.

title: P2pCall connect stage is handle Option + pending_signaling Vec + gate state
trigger: Signaling arrives before connect; connect/retry replaces the instance via retire_instance
effect: handle None means 'not connected yet' and 'instance retired'; pending_signaling must be empty exactly when handle is Some. No bug found today
fix: enum P2pStage { Waiting{pending_signaling}, Live{handle}, Ended } on P2pCall.

title: CallMediaConfig sends camera or screen via camera Option + screen_share_on bool (+ P2pCall::camera/screen handles)
trigger: Turn the camera on, then start screen share, then reconnect (retained_call_media keeps screen_share_on but takes camera from params)
effect: The 1:1 video source is a mode spread over config.camera, config.screen_share_on, P2pCall::camera and P2pCall::screen; they must agree by hand. No bug found today
fix: enum VideoSource { Off, Camera(device), Screen } in the config, with the native handle held in the matching variant.

title: Presentation::connected bool beside the instance handle; offers for a call and its screen are separate maps keyed by group call id
trigger: Start a presentation, the call ends or rejoins while the screen offer is being made
effect: Handled today by dropping the OfferRun (Unclaimed discards) and group_mut failing; the connected flag is a stage flag set from network callbacks
fix: Presentation stage enum (Making / Joining / Connected) and one offers map keyed by GroupOfferKey.

title: If the reaper thread failed to spawn or died, hand_off runs the destroy inline on the caller (UI) thread
trigger: Thread creation fails at start (spawn_guarded error is ignored with let _) or the receiver is gone; then hang up or switch calls while tgcalls teardown is slow
effect: qc_p2p_destroy / qc_group_destroy wait on tgcalls with no time limit, so the UI thread freezes (the reaper exists to prevent exactly this)
fix: Make Reaper::start return Result and fail engine load, or leak/park the job instead of running it inline.

title: connect_group marks the call connected before its fallible steps, so a retry reports success without finishing the join
trigger: Join a voice chat with the camera on while the camera cannot be opened (in use by another app or unplugged), or while qc_group_set_requested_video refuses the sources. connect_group sets connected=true, then apply_group_camera/sync_group_videos returns Err. connect/group_calls/mod.rs:157 stores transport_error and leaves transport_ready false; on the next poll it calls connect_group_call again.
effect: The second call hits `if call.connected { return Ok(()) }`, so the driver sets transport_ready=true, clears transport_error and records group_camera_state=Some(camera). The UI shows camera on and no error while the engine never opened the camera (and the mute/video setup after the failed step never ran).
fix: Make the join a typestate (Created, Joining, Connected{mode}) and enter Connected only after every step succeeded, or run the steps first and flip the stage last; a failed step leaves the stage at Joining so the retry redoes it.

title: P2pCall keeps its stage and media choices as parallel Options and a bool
trigger: Any 1:1 call: connect, retry connect, camera on/off, screen share on/off.
effect: No bug found today, but handle (None = not connected yet) decides whether pending_signaling is queued or delivered; media.screen_share_on mirrors screen.is_some(); media.camera (wanted device) mirrors camera (running source). These pairs are kept in step by hand in set_camera, set_screen_share_enabled, connect and retire_instance.
fix: One enum for the stage (Pending{signaling}, Connected{handle}) and one for the outgoing video (None, Camera{device,source}, Screen{source}) so camera and screen share cannot both be set.

title: GroupCall and Presentation use a connected bool beside mode, camera_id and camera
trigger: Any group call join, stream join, presentation start.
effect: GroupCall::connected is a stage flag; mode is only meaningful once connected (defaults to Rtc before, and set_streams_volume/group_stream_health read it without checking connected); camera_id (wanted) and camera (running) and group_sends() must agree. Presentation::connected is the same flag for the screen instance. TMP-001 is a bug this shape already caused.
fix: enum GroupStage { Created, Connected{mode} } and enum PresentationStage { Offered, Connected }, with mode readable only from the Connected variant.

title: An empty stream list overwrites the terminal Ended and Failed feeder states with NoStream
trigger: RTMP watch: a part reply returns GROUPCALL_INVALID (state Ended, Left outcome) while a getGroupCallStreams request is still in flight; that request then answers an empty list.
effect: on_streams_reply sets state=NoStream unconditionally, so stream_state() flips from Ended to NoStream and the watcher sees 'nobody is broadcasting' instead of the ended stream (live_feeds maps Ended to LiveEnd::Over). Same overwrite of Failed before the rejoin replaces the feeder.
fix: Make Ended and Failed terminal in one transition function (state.on_streams_empty() returns the same state for terminal variants), and drop streams_request when entering them.

title: StreamFeeder state is kept in step with streams_request, time_waiters and pending by hand
trigger: RTMP stream watch: time requests, stream list replies, cancels, drain.
effect: No bug found beyond TMP-004: Syncing is set only when state is Idle at the first time request and again from Idle/NoStream on a non-empty list; it does not mean a streams request is in flight (streams_request does). time_waiters are non-empty only while streams_request is Some, and drain/cancel must clear both.
fix: Fold streams_request and time_waiters into one variant (Syncing{request, waiters}) so waiters cannot outlive the request.

title: KeyFilter keeps its own held flag; a missed key-up leaves it stuck and the microphone open
trigger: Join a group call with push-to-talk and the system-wide hook on; hold the key; the hook misses the release (macOS event tap disabled by timeout and re-enabled in on_event, Windows on_key try_lock fails because CONTEXT is locked by a starting/stopping hook thread, X11 record gap); release the key. Because the hook is active, group_call_ptt_release_all returns early and never resets.
effect: KeyFilter.held stays true and PushToTalk.held/talking stay true: the microphone stays open (transmitting to the call) with no key down. The next press is swallowed (held == pressed returns None), the next release finally sends Up.
fix: Resync on hook gaps: drop the filter and send a synthetic Up when the tap is re-enabled or an event is skipped, or poll the real key state; one KeyState enum owned by the hook with a reset edge.

title: X11 record thread can end while the Controller still reports Active
trigger: Joined with push-to-talk on under X11; the record data connection errors (X server restart, reply Err) or record_enable_context fails in the thread; thread returns without telling anyone.
effect: Handle is still held by Controller (HookState::Active, status note 'Works system-wide'), but no key edges ever arrive: system-wide push-to-talk silently stops until the call or setting changes. If the key was down at that moment the microphone stays open (see key filter entry).
fix: Hook thread reports its end through the Sink or a shared HookLife enum (Running/Ended(reason)); Controller.sync treats an ended handle as Failed and restarts or surfaces it.

title: X11 keycodes for the key are captured once at start
trigger: Start push-to-talk with key 't' on layout A, then switch keyboard layout/remap so 't' is on another keycode.
effect: The hook keeps listening to the old keycode, so the configured key no longer triggers push-to-talk until the call is rejoined or the key setting changes.
fix: Re-resolve keycodes on MappingNotify or when the layout changes, or restart the hook.

title: Late hook thread of a timed-out start overwrites the live hook's global CONTEXT
trigger: Start of hook A takes over 2 s (start returns Failed, failed_for set); the user presses 'Check again' and hook B starts and installs CONTEXT; thread A then runs run_hook and replaces CONTEXT with its own (active already false), unhooks and clear_context removes it.
effect: Hook B is Active but its on_key finds CONTEXT empty: push-to-talk never fires while Settings says it works.
fix: Key the context per hook (hook thread owns its context via a thread-local or a map by hook id) instead of one global slot.

title: Controller keeps running, failed_for and state in step by hand
trigger: Any sync/retry sequence.
effect: Three fields describe one stage (Off, Active(key), Failed(key, reason)); state duplicates running/failed_for.
fix: One enum HookStage { Off, Active{key,handle}, Failed{key,err} } with HookState derived from it.

title: PushToTalk held / mute_at / talking are one stage kept in step by hand
trigger: Key down/up/tick/reset.
effect: Stages Idle, Held, Releasing(deadline) spread over two bools and an Option.
fix: enum PttStage { Idle, Held, Releasing{ mute_at } } (talking = not Idle).

title: MutedSpeechHint: showing, done, tester and was_live describe one hint stage
trigger: Speak while muted in a group call; unmute; dismiss; admin mute.
effect: Stages Listening, Showing, Done are encoded as showing/done bools plus tester Option, with update() clearing them by hand in several branches.
fix: enum HintStage { Idle, Listening{tester,due}, Showing, Done } owned per call_id.

title: RtmpStart: info Option, failed bool and a request list encode the Stream-with stages
trigger: Open 'Stream with...', fail or revoke the key.
effect: Stages WaitingFirstAnswer, BoxOpen, Revoking and a transient error are derived from info.is_some(), failed and requests; failed is a one-shot flag cleared per frame by the UI.
fix: enum RtmpStage { Fetching{req}, Ready{info, revoke: Option<req>}, } with the error returned as an event, not a flag.

title: One generating bool covers two independent link requests
trigger: Admin clicks Share Invite Link; the listener request fails while the speaker request is in flight (or the speaker send fails in request_video_chat_share_links, which then forces generating=false); click again.
effect: generating is false though a request is still in flight, so plan() sends the speaker request again (wanted.speaker = speaker.is_none()); duplicate requests, and a late answer from the first. After a revoke reset (session_apply_ok.rs:385) in-flight old answers are also stored as the new links.
fix: Per-link Fetch<String> for listener and speaker; ready/generating derived; reset drops in-flight answers by generation.

title: Playback watch falls back only once, even when the reopen failed
trigger: Watch a live stream whose output device vanishes; observe() returns OutputFailed and sets fell_back; reopen_stream_sound fails (device not back yet, stream.rs:251).
effect: fell_back is never cleared (entry removed only when the feeder closes), so the stream stays silent for the rest of the call with no further retry, though the device may return.
fix: enum WatchStage { Watching{live_since}, Reopened{attempts}, GaveUp } reset by the driver when reopen returns Ok or a new output is built.

title: Latest frame slot: unshown, wake_pending, waker and end are hand-kept together
trigger: Frames pushed with/without an armed waker; end then late pushes.
effect: Stages of the slot (Empty, FrameWaiting, Taken, Ended) and of the waker (Armed, WakePending) are bools/Options; documented and consistent today.
fix: enum FeedStage and enum Waker { Idle, Armed(w), Pending }.

title: SpeakerLevels keeps an ssrc forever when told_speaking is true and the driver stops accepting it
trigger: A participant is speaking (TDLib told speaking=true), then leaves the call so tell(ssrc) returns false.
effect: expire() retains the entry because told_speaking is true and speaking_changes never reports the stop; the entry lives until the levels are reset with the call (levels.rs:134). Small leak, no visible effect.
fix: Drop entries on participant removal, or make expire ignore told_speaking when tell() refuses the ssrc.

title: Playout primed bool is the Priming/Playing stage
trigger: Underrun then refill.
effect: primed toggles in fill() with the ring state; correct today.
fix: enum PlayoutStage { Priming, Playing }.
